intro2: Welcome to the digital heritage archive of Shri Bhagavati Pratishthan, Naleghar, Malgund, Ratnagiri. A place for our stories, traditions, annual publications and collective contributions.
heroNote: An illustration preserved from our original annual publication.

communityText: Meet the 2026 executive committee recorded in the annual report, and the community whose participation sustains the Pratishthan.
donateTitle: Together, we carry the tradition forward.
donateText: Annual subscriptions, voluntary contributions and gifts in kind are part of the community’s support recorded in the booklet.
committeeNote: 2026 executive committee · Transcribed from page 2. Page 3 names different signatories; this list follows the explicitly labelled 2026 committee.
communityIntro: Families, married daughters, relatives, friends, donors and well-wishers: the annual message recognises the many people who keep this community connected.
donationIntro: The published 2026 annual subscription is ₹1,500 for earning members of Naleghar. Bank details below have been checked against page 2 of the supplied booklet.
confirmBank: Confirm the account holder and current bank details directly with the Pratishthan before transferring funds.
receipt: After a transfer, the booklet asks contributors to share their name, amount and payment reference with Secretary Shri Sanjay Salvi via WhatsApp so that a receipt can be prepared. Contact details are in the original PDF.
archiveIntro: Original publications preserve the Pratishthan’s activities, community notices and contributions. The 2025–26 report is the first available volume in this digital collection.
galleryIntro: An archive of our shared moments, organised by year. Only years with supplied photographs appear as collections.
historical: Published records are presented in their historical context. Confirm current festival and visitor arrangements with the Pratishthan.
